paras: Introducing the Xforce Subaru WRX Race system with black tips – the ultimate upgrade for Subaru enthusiasts. This cat-back exhaust system is engineered to deliver our highest volume exhaust note while maintaining cabin drone to an absolute minimum, giving you raw performance sound without sacrificing comfort.

Crafted from high-quality 304 stainless steel, the Xforce Subaru Race System features mandrel-bent tubing and smooth transitions to maximize flow. It includes a cast stainless steel Y-piece with the XFORCE logo, high-flow rear resonators for aggressive tone, and a drone canister running parallel to the resonators to target and reduce in-cabin frequencies—providing a more refined driving experience even at high volume.
